scripts.check:go: go -C go vet ./... && go -C go test ./... && node contracts/cli.test.ts go
scripts.check:rust: cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml && node contracts/cli.test.ts rust
scripts.check:py: python -m unittest discover -s python && node contracts/cli.test.ts py
scripts.check: npm run check:go && npm run check:rust && npm run check:ts && npm run check:py
